text:
marta: Quick postmortem follow-up from yesterday's canary drift incident. TL;DR: root cause was a stale rollout policy + metric aggregation lag. We sussed a short-term mitigation but need tracked remediation items.

sam: Agree. Can we break into ownership + deadlines? Also flagging recurring pattern: small memory regressions in model-variant canaries every ~6 weeks.

leila: I'll own the metric lag diagnosis and a monitor rule change. Plan: add a dedicated canary-aggregation window and alert if canary divergence > 3% for 2 mins. Target: EOW (Fri). @sam fyi for alert routing. :calendar:

zack: I'll take the rollout policy hardening (auto-rollback thresholds + explicit blast-radius caps). Proposal posted below. ETA: 2 weeks.

marta: Thanks. Please put tickets in PM board and link here. We need owners in the postmortem.

jess: I'll own the retro action to surface recurring incidents to the reliability dashboard so teams see 'canary drift' history per service. ETA: next sprint.

deploy-bot: deploy:canary v2.8 -> started by @zack at 2154322500

zack: Proposed rollout gating (snippet):
```yaml
feature_flag: model_variant_v2
blast_radius: 5%
canary_window: 5m
metrics: [latency_p50, memory_rss, model_accuracy_delta]
auto_rollback:
  enabled: true
  threshold: 3%
  sustained_for: 2m
fallback_variants: [model_variant_v1, model_variant_quantized]
```

sam: Couple of notes:
- auto_rollback should include a cooldown so we don't oscillate between versions.
- we need a safe fallback routing that preserves KV caches where possible.

leila: +1 to cooldown. Suggest cooldown: 15m. Also adding a drift_score metric which is a weighted sum of normalized latency/accuracy change.

marta: Concrete action items (assignments):
- LEILA: adjust aggregation window + add alert (ticket INF-4123). Due: 2154380000 (Fri EOD).
- ZACK: rollout policy change + cooldown + PR to rollout-controller (ticket INF-4124). Due: 2155520000 (2 weeks).
- JESS: add recurring-incident card to reliability dashboard + dataset of canary anomalies (ticket ENG-78). Due: 2154960000 (next sprint start).
- SAM: draft testing checklist for canary rollback scenarios (ticket ENG-79). Due: 2154460000 (Mon).

zack: I'll also add a small integration test that simulates metric lag and ensures auto_rollback doesn't trigger false positives.

leila: For monitoring, I'll add a secondary signal: 'canary_latency_tail' to catch long-tail regressions missed by p50.

jess: For visibility, can we add a weekly 'canary health' digest to #eng-oncall and a monthly summary to SRE review? I can own the digest script.

marta: Yes. Add schedule to the ticket. Also mandatory: add an oncall-runbook snippet for this class of drift (INC-1234 style).

ops-bot: incident: INC-1234 reopened by @marta at 2154323600 - assigned to leila

sam: Follow-up checkpoints:
- Quick sync next Tue 10am to review initial metrics changes (30m).
- Rollout policy PR review by Thursday.
- Demo of dashboard integration at next SRE review.

marta: Ownership reminder: owners above are primary; please CC backups on your tickets. If any ETA slips, post here immediately.

zack: Question: do we want automatic feature-flag rollback across regions or per-region? For this pattern per-region seemed safer. Thoughts?

leila: Per-region to avoid global blips. But include global circuit-breaker if >50% regions affected.

jess: Noted. I'll include regional rollup charts in the dashboard data model.

marta: Ok — last bit: recurring pattern analysis. @jess can you produce a short write-up (1 page) showing past 6 months of canary anomalies and proposed thresholds by next sprint? That'll guide future auto_rollback tuning.

jess: Yep. Adding to ENG-78.

marta: Great work team. I'll update the postmortem with these action items and owners. Next check-in: Tue 10am (2154383600). :thumbsup:
